lines.text: This is not a prompt. It's a thirty-service pipeline.
One prompt doesn't hold a novel. It flatlines in chapter four.
AthenaOS splits the work across thirty numbered services. Each one has a written protocol.
Architecture. Character and world. Voice calibration. Drafting. Editing.
Before a word is drafted — a five-hundred-word voice fingerprint. Then a service whose only job is stripping the AI out.
Sixteen editing services. And at every seam — a gate. Including a naive reader who's never been briefed.
A governed pipeline. Thirty services. Five phases. A gate at every seam.
